title: PR 2b — purchase tax codes (AU GST/BAS, CA GST/HST/QST ITC, US sales tax as cost)

goals.text: computeLineTax in @agentbook/jurisdictions prices every AU/CA/US purchase code with the golden values (AU $110 incl -> $10, $0.99 -> $0.09, exclusive 10%, CA per-component rounding, QST only when qstRegistered, meals 0.5, US never recoverable, refunds symmetric), rates from the existing sales-tax providers only; lib/tax-codes is a thin adapter that passes region and registration through.

A registrant's typed expense posts DR category (net + non-recoverable) | DR 2100 (recoverable) | CR cash (gross); non-registrants and the US post gross with no tax row; unknown registration posts gross and prompts; the registration flags are validated tri-state in tenant-config and edited only in Business Profile. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key on a typed AU create yields one expense and one 3-line entry.

A typed expense's amount edit recomputes recoverableTaxCents from amount + taxCode, a category change moves only the net, delete reverses all three lines, and an uncategorised typed (3-line) expense reclassifies out of 6999 keeping its 2100 line (agentbook-expense-ledger-shapes.test.ts 'uncategorised -> categorised reclass moves the suspense debit and keeps the 2100 line'); every entry balances.

AU BAS 1B/G10/G11 and the CA ITC (incl. the QST ITR line) sum recoverableTaxCents for typed rows and fall back to taxAmountCents for untyped rows; gstRegistered === false gives 1B = 0 (golden mixed fixture).
Every table reader (deductions, category, vendor and trend reports) uses deductibleCents = amountCents - recoverableTaxCents; a guard fails on direct amountCents use in those modules.

Tax is prefilled and entered in the same confirm on mobile capture, the web New Expense form and chat ("$110 incl GST"); OCR keeps the printed tax and its label and flags a >2c mismatch; strings in en/fr-CA/zh-CN.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. The additive columns (AbExpense.taxCode, recoverableTaxCents; AbTenantConfig.qstRegistered, gstReportingBasis; AbVendor.defaultTaxCode) stay and are ignored. Typed rows written meanwhile keep their 3-line journals (DR category | DR 2100 | CR cash), which the PR 2a ledger writer can still edit and delete; reports fall back to reading taxAmountCents/amountCents as before.
